title: Snapshot cadence is elicited (weekly default, daily and off alternatives) and validated on the manifest
asA: operator whose project takes recovery-point snapshots on Hetzner Cloud
iWant: the elicited snapshot cadence value on hetzner/servers/name.json to match the shipped enum {weekly, daily, off}, with weekly the recommended default per ADR-3802
soThat: I have one project-wide answer for how often each server snapshots

acceptanceCriteria.description: manifest-schema-validate.mjs asserts every fixture manifest carries snapshotCadence with a value in the shipped enum {weekly, daily, off}; a manifest missing the field FAILS schema validation naming the missing field.

Scheduled snapshot fires per elicited cadence. Given snapshotCadence = weekly and hetznerManagedBackups = false, when the scheduled snapshot runner ticks past the weekly boundary against the throwaway server, then hcloud image list --type=snapshot --output json shows a fresh snapshot tagged with the server name and current wall-clock time; hetznerScheduledSnapshotTaken fires on the event sink with snapshot id, cadence and time. A mutation snapshotCadence = off suppresses the scheduled run and asserts no new snapshot appears.
acceptanceCriteria.given: snapshotCadence = weekly, hetznerManagedBackups = false, throwaway server present
acceptanceCriteria.when: the scheduled snapshot runner ticks past the weekly boundary
acceptanceCriteria.then: hcloud image list --type=snapshot shows a fresh tagged snapshot; hetznerScheduledSnapshotTaken fires with snapshot id, cadence, time; snapshotCadence=off produces no new snapshot
